title: MOFA response to erroneous article by Solomon Islands media outlet claiming Taiwan uses financial assistance to secure diplomatic ties
text:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemns a malicious report published on September 1 by Solomon Islands media outlet Solomon Star. The report clearly deviated from the facts, erroneously stating that Taiwan used financial assistance to secure diplomatic recognition.

First, numerous statements in the report, including the claim that Taiwan offers cash gifts to prominent political figures in Palau, are completely untrue. Furthermore, Taiwan’s cooperation initiatives with Palau and other diplomatic allies, including Palau’s use of funding provided by Taiwan, focus on meeting local needs and uphold the administrative procedures of both parties. In such instances, Taiwan follows the same principles used by other like-minded countries in collaborative projects in the Pacific region.

By offering financial assistance to support the national development of diplomatic allies, Taiwan seeks to not only strengthen ties with its partners but also fulfill its obligations as a responsible member of the international community. Taiwan’s related policies emphasize investment in allied countries and encourage domestic manufacturers and enterprises to participate. Over the years, these efforts have yielded tangible results in such areas as clean energy, health care, and infrastructure for Taiwan’s allies.

Previously, foreign media have reported that certain Solomon Islands media outlets were receiving funding from China, casting doubt on the independence and impartiality of those outlets. It is regrettable that this most recent misleading article by Solomon Star reinforces such concerns and falls short of journalistic independence, fairness, and professionalism.

Taiwan has always upheld the spirit of the Pacific Way when interacting with nations in the region. Through the integrated diplomacy policy promoted by Minister of Foreign Affairs Lin Chia-lung and the Diplomatic Allies Prosperity Project, Taiwan engages in exchanges and cooperation with its allies, other friendly countries in the region, and the Pacific Islands Forum.

As a responsible member of the Pacific family and a force for good, Taiwan has long contributed to regional peace and prosperity initiatives, with its efforts receiving wide recognition. In the future, Taiwan will continue to uphold shared ideals and move forward hand in hand with other nations in the Pacific.
